newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura Securities slips in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Nomura Securities slips in early morning.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd shares slipped in early trade on Monday, still depressed by the firm's admission last Thursday that it was highly likely that two of its directors had been involved in illegal deals, brokers said.
As of 0020 GMT, the shares were down 40 yen at 1,490. Volume stood at 2.049 million shares, making it the 10th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"Depending on the outcome of the investigations and the punitive measures taken against the brokerage, not only will Nomura's business be hurt, but the image of the industry will be tarnished as well," a "Big Four" broker said.
